# Divine Paradox

> Montana-born production house with 25+ years of design and web development
> experience. We make visual art, and we build websites for Missoula
> businesses with everything handled.

## Services

- Visual art and production: story-first creative, Montana-born, est. 2025
- Missoula web design and care: $1,500 build + $300/month (or $0 build with a
  12-month agreement) covering hosting, security, AI-search readiness, and
  one content update per month.
